subject: xxh128: slight optimization for len [4,8]
perf_evidence: Commit changes how length enters the 4..8-byte multiplication to improve speed and hash quality.
change_summary: Changes the XXH3 128-bit 4..8-byte mixing formula from postmultiply length adjustments to a length-dependent multiplier.

units.name: public XXH3_128bits, withSeed and withSecret, length 4..8
units.evidence: All three public API targets yield Alive2 forward value-in-memory counterexamples for valid lengths; both directions fail.

units.name: raw fixed-length 4 and 8 witnesses
units.evidence: Both fixed-length raw wrappers yield forward and backward Alive2 counterexamples.

notes: The changed hash formula is observed through all public XXH3 128-bit variants on its entire length class.
